title: High-Throughput Serving of Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe with Regime-Aware Megakernels and Kernel Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2611.20095v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe ranks first among open-weight models on the Hugging Face Open ASR leaderboards. Serving it efficiently takes more than fast operators: continuous batching changes the amount and mix of work at every iteration, and the best fusion granularity changes with it. We present a serving engine that, for every pass, chooses between persistent megakernels and chains of fused kernels at crossovers measured offline. On an H100 SXM GPU, throughput of our accuracy-preserving serving peaks at 4,345x real time, 1.39x the peak of tuned vLLM, and is up to 4.39x faster at low concurrency; on B200 it peaks at 6,367x, 1.64x vLLM at the highest concurrency we measured. Word error rate (WER) is 1.91 to 1.93% against 1.88 to 1.93% for vLLM. Within a 400 ms budget for p95 end-to-end completion time, it serves 8x as many concurrent requests. translated_title: 基于状态感知巨型内核与内核融合的Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe高吞吐量服务
translated_abstract: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe在Hugging Face开放权重模型Open ASR排行榜上排名第一。高效地服务该模型不仅仅是需要快速的算子：连续批处理会在每次迭代中改变工作量和任务组合方式，最佳融合粒度也随之变化。我们提出了一种服务引擎，它在每次推理遍历时，根据离线测量得到的交叉点，在持久化巨型内核和融合内核链之间进行选择。在H100 SXM GPU上，我们这种保持精度的服务方案峰值吞吐量达到4,345倍实时速度，是调优后vLLM峰值的1.39倍，在低并发场景下最高快4.39倍；在B200上峰值达到6,367倍实时速度，在我们测量的最高并发下是vLLM的1.64倍。词错误率（WER）为1.91%至1.93%，而vLLM为1.88%至1.93%。在p95端到端完成时间400毫秒的预算内，它可服务的并发请求数量是原来的8倍。每次遍历动态选择比单独使用任一策略都更好：比始终使用巨型内核的吞吐量高出23%。
tldr: 该论文提出一种状态感知的服务引擎，在每次推理遍历时根据离线测量的交叉点在持久化巨型内核与融合内核链之间动态选择，使Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe在H100上达到4,345倍实时的吞吐量（为vLLM的1.39倍），并在相同的400毫秒延迟预算下支持8倍的并发请求数量。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a regime-aware serving engine that dynamically chooses between persistent megakernels and fused kernel chains at offline-measured crossovers for each pass, achieving 4,345x real-time throughput for Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe on H100 (1.39x tuned vLLM) and serving 8x more concurrent requests within the same 400 ms latency budget.
